ui.app.title: Primum
ui.outputs.heading: Outputs
ui.panic.description: Turns every output off and stops accepting commands.
ui.panic.active: Panic is active: every output is off and commands are refused.
ui.connection.offline: No connection with the service. Retrying…

hal.pin_in_use.message: Pin {pin} is already used by another output.
hal.pin_in_use.hint: Choose a different pin for one of them.

hal.pin_invalid.message: Pin {pin} does not exist on this board.
hal.pin_invalid.hint: Check the pin number against the board's pinout.

hal.pin_unavailable.message: Pin {pin} is being used by something else on this board.
hal.pin_unavailable.hint: Free it (stop the program or turn off the interface that uses it) or choose another pin.

hal.profile_mismatch.message: The board profile puts pin {pin} on line {line}, but the GPIO controller {chip} has {lines} lines.
hal.profile_mismatch.hint: The profile does not match this board: check that Primum is configured for the right board, or report it.

hal.chip_unavailable.message: The GPIO controller {chip} cannot be opened.
hal.chip_unavailable.hint: Check that Primum is configured for this board.

hal.chip_access_denied.message: Primum has no permission to use the GPIO controller {chip}.
hal.chip_access_denied.hint: Add the user that runs Primum to the gpio group, then restart the service.

hal.unsupported_platform.message: Real hardware cannot be used on this system ({platform}).
hal.unsupported_platform.hint: Run Primum on a Raspberry Pi, or start it in simulation mode.

hal.gpio_library_broken.message: The GPIO library is installed but incomplete, so real hardware cannot be used.
hal.gpio_library_broken.hint: Reinstall Primum on this board; if it happens again, report it with the technical detail.

hal.closed.message: The connection to the hardware is closed.

hal.safe_state_incomplete.message: Pins {pins} could not be put in their safe state.
hal.safe_state_incomplete.hint: Cut the power of what is wired to them, then check the wiring.

hal.release_incomplete.hint: Restart the board before using them again.

output.unknown.hint: Reload the page to see the current outputs.

panic.active.message: Panic is active: outputs do not accept commands.
panic.active.hint: Release panic when it is safe to continue.

request.invalid.hint: Reload the page. If it happens again, report it with the technical detail.

request.not_found.hint: Reload the page. If it happens again, report it with the technical detail.

request.method_not_allowed.message: The service does not accept this action at {path}.
request.method_not_allowed.hint: Reload the page. If it happens again, report it with the technical detail.

file.not_utf8.message: The file is not UTF-8 text.
file.not_utf8.hint: Save it again with UTF-8 encoding.

file.invalid_json.message: The file is not valid JSON (line {line}, column {column}).
file.invalid_json.hint: Fix the text near that position, or restore the file from a copy.

file.duplicate_key.message: The key {key} appears twice in the same object.

file.not_an_object.message: The file does not contain a JSON object.
file.not_an_object.hint: A Primum file starts with { and ends with }.

schema.missing_field.hint: Add it: this format requires it.

schema.unknown_field.message: The field {field} is not part of this format.
schema.unknown_field.hint: Remove it, or check how it is spelled.

schema.expected_text.hint: Write it between double quotes, like "Shop window".

schema.expected_integer.message: The field {field} must be a whole number.
schema.expected_integer.hint: Write it without quotes or decimals, like 17.

schema.expected_number.message: The field {field} must be a number.
schema.expected_number.hint: Write it without quotes, like 0.5 or 2.

schema.expected_boolean.message: The field {field} must be true or false.
schema.expected_boolean.hint: Write true or false, without quotes.

schema.expected_list.message: The field {field} must be a list.
schema.expected_list.hint: Write it between square brackets, like [1, 2].

schema.expected_object.message: The field {field} must be a group of fields.
schema.expected_object.hint: Write it between curly braces, like {"name": "LED"}.

schema.not_allowed.message: The value of {field} is not one of the allowed values.

schema.invalid_id.message: The value of {field} is not a valid id.
schema.invalid_id.hint: An id is a UUID such as 8d0f6f1e-3b2a-4c55-9a51-1f2d3c4b5a69; let Primum create it.

schema.invalid_value.message: The value of {field} is not valid.
schema.invalid_value.hint: Check it against the description of the format.

schema.too_short.message: The text of {field} is too short.

schema.too_long.message: The text of {field} is too long.
schema.too_long.hint: It can have at most {max} characters.

schema.below_minimum.message: The value of {field} is too small.

schema.above_maximum.message: The value of {field} is too large.

schema.unsupported_version.message: The file uses version {version} of its format, and this version of Primum reads version {supported}.
schema.unsupported_version.hint: Open it with a version of Primum that reads that format.

board.duplicate_pin.message: The board profile lists physical pin {physical} more than once.
board.duplicate_pin.hint: Keep one entry per pin of the header.

board.power_pin_with_gpio.message: Physical pin {physical} is a power or ground pin, but the profile gives it a GPIO, a line or a pull.
board.power_pin_with_gpio.hint: Remove those fields, or mark the pin as gpio.

board.incomplete_gpio_pin.message: Physical pin {physical} is a GPIO, but the profile does not give its GPIO number, its line and its pull.
board.incomplete_gpio_pin.hint: Add gpio, line and defaultPull to the pin.

board.duplicate_gpio.message: The board profile gives GPIO {gpio} to more than one pin.
board.duplicate_gpio.hint: Each GPIO is on one pin of the header: check the pinout.

board.duplicate_line.message: The board profile maps more than one GPIO to line {line} of the GPIO chip.
board.duplicate_line.hint: Check the line of each GPIO against the board's GPIO chip.

board.unknown_gpio.message: The board profile uses GPIO {gpio}, which none of its pins has.
board.unknown_gpio.hint: Use a GPIO listed in the profile's pins.

board.duplicate_id.message: The board profile uses the name {id} more than once.
board.duplicate_id.hint: Give each bus and each PWM channel its own name.
